question: Name the vehicle developed by DRDO to detect and dispose a bomb.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Daksh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daksh** is a **remotely operated vehicle** developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** in India.
 
• It is designed to detect, handle, and safely dispose of explosive devices, including bombs.
 
• features of Daksh:
 
• **Bomb Disposal**: Equipped with robotic arms and specialized tools to defuse and safely dispose of bombs and other explosive devices.
 
• **Remote Operation**: It can be operated from a safe distance, ensuring the safety of personnel handling dangerous materials.
 
• **Versatile Mobility**: Daksh is capable of climbing stairs and traversing rough terrain, which makes it suitable for various environments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rakshak**:
 
• Rakshak is an armoured vehicle developed for the Indian armed forces and police, primarily for **personnel protection** and **patrol duties** in high-risk areas.
 
• **Vajra**:
 
• K9 Vajra is a **155mm self-propelled artillery gun** system designed for long-range firepower in the Indian Army, developed in collaboration with South Korean defence technology. 
 
• **Prahar**:
 
• Prahar is a **tactical surface-to-surface missile** system developed by DRDO.
 
 
• It is designed for precision strikes and short-range tactical uses but is unrelated to bomb disposal.
